about.description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
about.head: a0e4295

name: v2.2.1
body:
### Fixes
- fix: omp read with a line range in the path is a bounded read, not replaced (#1392)
- fix: recall skips rows and line units written after the latest compaction (#1394)
- fix: SessionStart(compact) sends the state block once per compaction, not once per session (#1396)
- fix: ctx_search names an unknown explicit source and the stored sources (#1390)
- fix: setup keeps a working OpenCode install when the host list command exits non-zero (#1386)
- fix: rtk proxy / bypass reads get the same Codex size check as the plain command (#1388)
- fix: Windows mkdir EPERM on the context.db publish claim waits like EEXIST (#1385, D-1385-NOLINK-2)
- fix: doctor lists a v1 data dir setup keeps as a note, not a FAIL (#1383)
- fix: subagent with no route to the stored output gets it whole; built-in claude gets ctx_search (#1382)
- fix: Pi >= 1.5 gets the payload as a named section, so <mcp_servers> stays (#1384)
- fix: publish a fresh context.db where link() is denied (EACCES/EPERM on Android f2fs) (#1385)

### Who gets this

One version on both channels: the release commit on main (GitHub) and npm.

| Agent | Channel | Update with |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | GitHub | `claude plugin update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Codex | GitHub, npm for the one-time hook trust step | `codex plugin marketplace upgrade context-mode` |
| Gemini CLI | GitHub | `gemini extensions update context-mode` |
| Qwen Code | GitHub | `qwen extensions update context-mode` |
| Copilot CLI | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| VS Code (Copilot) | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| Kiro | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| ZCode | GitHub | `zcode plugins update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Pi | npm | `pi update --extensions` |
| OpenCode | npm | `opencode plugin update` |
| OMP | npm | `omp plugin upgrade context-mode` |
